lessons_used: Predictions were overall overly optimistic, yet consistently underpredicted performance for major winning tests.

Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and new finish flows (finish, new_flow) proved helpful, driving significant winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) consistently generated negative metrics or guardrail rollbacks.

Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), home new flows (home, new_flow), sign-in copy changes (sign_in, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently resulted in no clear effect across multiple tests.

Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow/redesign, sign_in layout/new_flow/redesign), requiring at least 2 tests to confirm a pattern.
